```python
import polars as pl

# Create sample long-format data
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["New York", "Boston", "New York", "Boston"],
    "temperature": [32.0, 28.5, 35.2, 31.1]
})

# Reshape from long to wide format
wide_df = df.pivot(on="city", values="temperature", index="date")

print(wide_df)
```
